title: CDA Compressor: mean-line design and off-design analysis of axial compressors
description: Two linked MATLAB apps and a launcher for the mean-line preliminary design (design space, selection, row-by-row design, comparison) and off-design analysis (performance maps, choke, peak pressure ratio, Howell stall onset, stall and choke margins, Greitzer B, Koch indicator, validation and correlation sensitivity) of rotor-stator and rotor-rotor axial compressors. Includes the design files of the eight designs and the NACA validation cases of the associated paper.
